scope.purpose: Show that something is loading when the duration is unknown and the place is small.
useCases: In an empty panel while its content loads.
The loading state of a control (Button and IconButton draw the same ring today).
exclusions: Color options: the spinner inherits the current content color.
alternatives: Skeleton for the first load of a region.

checks.name: npm run validate (schema, consistency, token coverage in 18 contexts, dependencies)
npm run build:tokens (coverage and contrast evidence)

decisionsTaken: Same drawing as the Button loading indicator (ring r 9 in a 24 box, stroke 2.5, quarter arc), so that a later Modify can make Button and IconButton use the Spinner without a visual change.
Sizes sm, md, lg, xl on size.icon.* (16, 20, 24, 32 px).
Color inherited (currentColor); track at the new opacity.track (0.2; Button uses 0.25 hard-coded).
label empty by default: decorative; a non-empty label makes it a polite status.
One turn per motion.duration.spin (new role, primitive 700 ms; Button hard-codes 800 ms), three times slower under reduced motion (the Button rule).
openDecisions: 5. Spinner speed: motion.duration.spin aliases the existing primitive 700 ms (Button and IconButton hard-code 800 ms today); after the wave, a Modify makes Button and IconButton draw the Spinner and use the role (a 100 ms faster turn). Alternative: a new primitive 800 ms to keep the reviewed speed.
nextAction: Wave 3 contract gate: present the contract with the other wave 3 contracts and record the approval.
